title: Scout replay sweep grid v1
description: One document describing a whole study: projects x prompts x backends, with the models each backend serves. `scout feedback grid expand` turns it into the replay-sweep v1 files and the run script that batch-replay consumes, plus a manifest that records every cell's attributes (model, backend, quant, reasoning, prompt, project, repeat) so results can be pooled by attribute instead of by name.

task_config.description: Relevance task config path, as passed to batch-replay --task-config (resolved by the runner, not the expander).

prompts.description: Named candidate system prompts. null reuses each baseline case's recorded prompt. `file` is one file for every project; `files` maps project name to file. Paths are relative to the grid document.

identity_config.description: JSON file exported as SCOUT_MODEL_IDENTITY_CONFIG by the run script.

env.description: Extra environment for every batch-replay of this backend (e.g. OLLAMA_HOST). Keys must be POSIX variable names.

id.description: Stable model identity shared across backends (e.g. gemma-4-26b-a4b).

model.description: Routable model string for batch-replay (openrouter/..., ollama/...).

quant.description: Weight format when not the provider default (Q4_K_M, Q8_0, fp8).

reasoning.description: Recorded in the manifest and the variant name. Not yet enforced by batch-replay: one backend environment serves every variant of a sweep, so all explicit values within a backend must agree (checked at load).

only.description: Keep only cells matching at least one selector.

skip.description: Drop cells matching any selector; applied after `only`.

repeats.description: Expand every cell this many times (-r2, -r3 ... suffixes) for run-to-run variance.
